text:
sara_sales: Heads-up: Prospect Emerald Edge (finance) wants to run a 2-week eval with their proprietary adapter and our runtime. Model name: Orpheus-65B-lite (not in our catalog). Need a quick compatibility/operational check + pricing delta. @rajesh_se do we have a short preflight checklist?
rajesh_se: On it. Quick question — is their adapter doing weight-sharding or just a tokenizer/LoRA shim? That changes KV cache layout and batching behavior.
molly_research: LoRA attachments are usually fine, but layer-norm variant matters. Also need model format (safetensors vs pt), tokenizer type, and quantization level. Can you paste metadata?
sara_sales: Sent by customer: format=hf_safetensors, norm=rmsnorm, quant=int8, tokenizer=bpe-50k. They also attached a tiny inference trace. Security ask: they need KMS integration and SOC2 evidence for the POC.
rajesh_se: Runtime notes: rmsnorm + int8 => kernel fallback required on older GPUs. On Dedicated it's safe; on Hosted we'll need to pin to A100/RTX40 families or accept a perf hit. Memory ballpark: with 4k context expect ~18GB GPU working set with current quant.
molly_research: I'll run a quick compatibility label: probably compatible but flag runtime-dependency=rmsnorm-kernel & host-gpu-selection-required. Also flag for eval: small risk of subtle tokenization drift with bpe-50k.
julian_solutions: Buyer asked about pricing: can we offer a 2-week trial with a 50% discount on hosted tokens and waive initial setup? What's ops impact? @sara_sales
sara_sales: They want low friction. Proposed approach: initial smoke on a Dedicated burst node for the first 48h to validate outputs, then move to pinned hosted capacity. Need cost delta for dedicated burst + token cost estimate at ~1M tokens/day.
finance_bot: Quote calc: Dedicated burst (1 x p4d-style node) + 8 engineer hours for runbook = ~$4,200/week. Token profiling (Orpheus-65B-lite on hosted) ~= $0.00018/token -> 1M tokens/day ≈ $180/day. If we offer 50% for 14 days, trial discount ≈ $1,260.
rajesh_se: Security checklist: for KMS we need their key policy and whether they require customer-managed keys in Hosted. Customer-managed KMS on Hosted requires infra + legal sign-off. Also SSO/SCIM provisioning for their reviewers — who owns that?
sara_sales: Legal + customer security will handle the questionnaire but engineering needs a one-page handoff describing data flow, where keys live, and what logs are produced for SOC2.
molly_research: I can draft the handoff note and run a small accuracy check against our privacy-safe eval prompts. I'll need 50 validation prompts + expected labels from the customer.
sara_sales: I'll request the prompts and repo access today. Tentative timeline: today – confirm repo access; +48h – first smoke test on Dedicated; +7d – full output evaluation; +14d – decision point.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: Dedicated burst node provision requested by sara_sales. Request ID: DB-9281. ETA ~3h. :rocket:
rajesh_se: Fallback plan if we hit perf regressions: try an int4 quant variant or fall back to Orpheus-13B for the POC. We'll call these out in the handoff note.
sara_sales: Great — thanks! @molly_research @rajesh_se can you deliver the compatibility label + one-page handoff note in the next 24h? I'll update the buyer and attach the security questionnaire heads-up.
